question: Which categories are gaining or losing share over time?

tool_calls.query:
SELECT 
  p.category,
  CASE
    WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 'Mar 2026'
    WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 'Apr 2026'
    WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-29' THEN 'May 2026'
  END AS period,
  SUM(i.line_total) AS category_sales,
  SUM(SUM(i.line_total)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 'Mar 2026' WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 'Apr 2026' WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-29' THEN 'May 2026' END) AS period_total,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(i.line_total) / SUM(SUM(i.line_total)) OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31' THEN 'Mar 2026' WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-30' THEN 'Apr 2026' WHEN DATE(t.txn_ts) BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-05-29' THEN 'May 2026' END), 2) AS share_pct
FROM tenant_transaction_items i
JOIN tenant_transactions t ON t.txn_id = i.txn_id
JOIN tenant_products p ON p.sku = i.sku
WHERE t.merchant_id = 'TJX'
GROUP BY p.category, period
ORDER BY category, period
LIMIT 100;
